v.n: What is CYBERWORLD? - An Introduction to Transformers:…

eps.o: Optimus Prime finds himself tumbling headfirst onto a strange and hostile alien planet. His attempts to discover more about his surroundings are met with violent onslaughts from the monstrous Scorponok and the fearsome Grimlock, who chases Optimus through the Jungle.
Bumblebee battles Megatron in a target shooting challenge while Optimus Prime races through the jungle, away from Grimlock, to reach his old friend.

After Bumblebee is wounded by Megatron, he and Optimus Prime race to a mysterious crate drop that could provide them with powerful upgrades. But they're not the only ones! Grimlock and Snarl are after the loot themselves - will Optimus and Bumblebee get there first?

Optimus Prime and Bumblebee are travelling the banks of the river, in the Jungle region, when they are surprised by the arrival of Elita-1 - in the midst of a dangerous high speed race against her rival Sky-Byte. Misunderstanding the stakes, Optimus and Bumblebee force their way onto the track, disrupting the game and kicking off a fight between the hapless trio and an emboldened Sky-Byte.

Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, and Elita-1 sneak into Cyber City on a covert mission for crucial intel - but the shadows hide surprises and secrets alike. Bumbebee receives a rare item drop, but things are not what they seem and not before long, the heroes are thrown into a dizzying maze of illusions.

Get ready for the ultimate Bot Battle Royale! Optimus Prime and his team sneak into Cyber City with Mirage, but things don't go as planned. Now they are stuck in a last-bot-standing challenge against the city's most powerful ruler! Who will survive the arena?

To stand a chance against the ruthless Scorponok, Optimus Prime and the team set out to recruit the Dinobots. But things don’t go as planned and Optimus is forced into a dangerous challenge: a hunter-versus-hunted showdown with Grimlock himself!

Optimus Prime and his team enter Cyberworld's toughest challenge yet: a vertical race straight up into the sky. However, Optimus comes face to face with his enemy, Megatron for the first time on Cyberworld. With both teams racing for the Energon, who will make it to the top first?

After losing to Megatron, Optimus, Bumblebee, Elita-1 and Grimlock try one last plan: take down Scorponok and capture the crashed ship. If they win, they can finally find a way home. But Scorponok is stronger than they ever imagined, and team Optimus is running out of time. Will they escape or will this be their final battle?
Chop Shop's secret side-mission for hidden treasure leads Bumblebee into a trap! Will he be able to find the prize and escape in time?

In need of more energon, Elita suggests that the team split up to earn energon faster, separately. Team Optimus decide to split up and compete in separate challeges to see which of them can gain the most energon the fastest.

A chance encounter in a sandstorm leads Optimus, Elita, and Bumblebee to Ron - a lone survivor hiding more than just scrap metal. When a strange creature begins to hunt them, the truth about Ron’s past may change everything.
Out of Energon and out of luck, Optimus and his team jump at the chance to recharge! ... but instead, they’re dragged into a dark and twisted Trick or Treat challenge!

Two squads drop into an all-out team shooter showdown! Bumblebee is learning that playing support isn’t as easy as it looks and his teammates are feeling the pain. Meanwhile, Mirage carries game-changing intel that could turn the tide, but convincing Optimus to believe him might be the toughest mission yet.
Team Optimus launch a high-stakes heist inside Megatron’s lair to steal data on Scorponok: their only hope of escaping Cyberworld! What they uncover might be more powerful than they ever imagined…

It's NOW or never! Optimus Prime and his team face Scorponok in an epic final battle on Cyberworld. With time running out, they’ll need every trick in the book to make it to the ship and escape. Can the Autobots SURVIVE and save the day or will Scorponok claim his final victory?

With Megatron out of the picture, Optimus Prime and his team are free to make their escape in the ship - but with a storm approaching they need to get it off the ground in time, whilst keeping it safe from a wild and unpredictable Scorponok.

After the revelations during Optimus Prime, Bumblebee and Elita-1's attempt to escape from CYBERWORLD, the events of Elita's past altercation with Sky-Byte may hold clues as to Wheeljack's ultimate fate. But the status quo on the world is now threatened.

Team Optimus just jumped into the MOST INTENSE ocean platformer challenge yet! To uncover the truth about Wheeljack, Elita-1, Optimus Prime and Bumblebee take on a relentless co-op time-trial over the open ocean and the slightest mistake can send them straight down! Can they beat the clock, or will the ocean win?

Wheeljack enters Starscream's Cyber City and faces a repair challenge with time running out. With the clock ticking and Starscream watching, the pressure is on. Can Wheeljack finish in time or will something go wrong?

When Wheeljack is captured by Starscream, Optimus Prime leads a daring rescue mission straight into enemy territory. Outnumbered by attack drones, the Autobots must fight fast and escape before time runs out. Can Optimus Prime defeat the drone army and save his friend?

Starscream is hunting the Autobots through Cyber City - and getting caught means game over. No time to reunite, no time to explain - just RUN. Mirage confronts Wheeljack about his "death," secrets start spilling, and trust is breaking fast.

Optimus Prime and his team discover another mysterious crate drop! But they're not alone… The fearsome Dinobot Snarl is back and ready to battle - and this time, there are even more surprise loot hunters joining the fight! Who will win the crate and claim the prize?

The King of Dinobots is running on empty ... but refuses to stop. What starts as a desert race quickly spirals into a high-risk mission as Snarl is forced to keep him alive against relentless hazards, enemy interference, and Grimlock's own stubborn drive to prove he’s still at full strength. This isn't just about winning the race. It's about knowing when to push forward… and when to let your…

Optimus Prime leads the team into a hidden system beneath Cyberworld: and this isn't just a discovery mission. It's a trap. As they push deeper, every step triggers something new: laser grids, collapsing paths, and environments designed to stop anyone from reaching the truth. Wheeljack warns them to turn back, but Optimus is certain there’s something important buried below. With no clear way out…

A relentless energy wall is closing in ... and the only option is to run. Optimus Prime leads the team across a dangerous ocean route where the path ahead is unstable, the pace keeps increasing, and one mistake could mean being swallowed whole. As the pressure builds, cracks begin to show. Optimus is distracted, the memories he’s been experiencing are getting stronger, and the team must decide…

The team is forced into a rhythm-based challenge, and there’s no way out but to keep moving. What starts as a strange program quickly turns into a test of timing, coordination, and teamwork as Optimus Prime, Elita-1, Bumblebee, and Wheeljack try to survive a deceptively difficult dance gauntlet.

Sky-Byte is back and this time, Elita-1 is ready for him. After tensions split the team apart, Optimus Prime races to find Bumblebee before things spiral any further. But while they’re gone, Wheeljack and Elita-1 are forced into a dangerous showdown across the Ocean Region with their old enemy Sky-Byte. What begins as a high-speed marine race quickly turns personal as rivalries reignite and the…

Airachnid has lured Elita-1 and Wheeljack into her web-ring and she's ready to settle old scores once and for all. When Optimus Prime and Bumblebee storm the arena to make the save, the stage is set for an unforgettable showdown. Body slams, aerial attacks, surprise reversals and web-powered chaos take over the ring as Elita-1 goes head-to-head with her longtime nemesis. In this no-holds-barred…

Team Prime takes on the Dinobots in a high-speed Rocket Boost Challenge to earn valuable Energon and strengthen their alliance. But while the competition heats up, Wheeljack uncovers a mysterious energy surge that could threaten the future of Cyberworld itself.

Optimus Prime undergoes a brain procedure to unlock the memories hidden inside his visions. While Airachnid explores his mind, Wheeljack uncovers new evidence behind the mysterious energy fluctuations affecting Cyberworld. But the deeper they dig, the clearer it becomes that a much bigger threat is waiting to be discovered.

Bumblebee is locked inside a Cyber Prison and the only way out is to escape! While the Autobots battle through a chaotic challenge, Optimus Prime goes head-to-head with the unstoppable Galvatron. But with the team divided and trust at an all-time low, winning may be their toughest challenge yet.

eps.t: For the Win I: Dragon's Lair (1)
eps.o: Galvatron is stronger than ever, and Optimus Prime is completely outmatched.

eps.t: For the Win II: Threat from Above (2)
eps.o: Optimus Prime has fallen into danger, and Galvatron isn't slowing down. As the Autobots race to save their leader, they'll need a new plan to stop Galvatron before it's too late. Can they pull off the impossible?

eps.t: For the Win III: For Cyberworld (3)
eps.o: The final battle begins, with Optimus and Bumblebee on opposite sides.
